        var statisticsGroupId = 'C0002';
        var cookieNames = ['ai_user', 'ai_session'];

        function activeGroups() {
            return String(window.OnetrustActiveGroups || window.OptanonActiveGroups || '');
        }

        function hasStatisticsConsent() {
            var active = ',' + activeGroups() + ',';
            if (active.indexOf(',' + statisticsGroupId + ',') !== -1) {
                return true;
            }

            var oneTrust = window.OneTrust;
            if (!oneTrust || typeof oneTrust.GetDomainData !== 'function') {
                return false;
            }

            var groups = (oneTrust.GetDomainData() || {}).Groups || [];
            for (var i = 0; i < groups.length; i++) {
                var group = groups[i] || {};
                var name = String(group.GroupName || '').toLowerCase();
                if (name.indexOf('statistic') === -1 && name.indexOf('performance') === -1) {
                    continue;
                }

                var id = group.CustomGroupId || group.OptanonGroupId;
                if (id && active.indexOf(',' + id + ',') !== -1) {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        function getCookieManager() {
            var instance = window.appInsights;
            if (!instance) {
                return null;
            }

            if (typeof instance.getCookieMgr === 'function') {
                return instance.getCookieMgr();
            }

            if (instance.core && typeof instance.core.getCookieMgr === 'function') {
                return instance.core.getCookieMgr();
            }

            return null;
        }

        function deleteCookie(name) {
            var expired = name + '=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path=/';
            document.cookie = expired;
            if (window.location.hostname) {
                document.cookie = expired + '; domain=' + window.location.hostname;

        function syncAppInsightsCookies() {
            var granted = hasStatisticsConsent();
            var cookieManager = getCookieManager();

            if (cookieManager && typeof cookieManager.setEnabled === 'function') {
                cookieManager.setEnabled(granted);
            }

            if (!granted) {
                for (var i = 0; i < cookieNames.length; i++) {
                    if (cookieManager && typeof cookieManager.del === 'function') {
                        cookieManager.del(cookieNames[i]);
                    }

                    deleteCookie(cookieNames[i]);
                }
            }
        }

        function watchUntilSdkReady() {
            var attempts = 0;
            var timer = window.setInterval(function () {
                attempts += 1;
                syncAppInsightsCookies();
                if (getCookieManager() || attempts >= 40) {

        };

        (function () {

                if (document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-embed') === 'true') return;
                if (document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-visual-builder-preview') === 'true') return;

                var pendingKey = 'bentley.pendingSilentSsoAfterCommerce';
                var loopKey = 'bentley.silentSsoAttemptAt';
                // Align with AccountController silent-attempt cookie (~15s).
                var loopMs = 15 * 1000;
                // Drop stale pending flags (e.g. abandoned Commerce tab).
                var pendingMaxAgeMs = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
                var scheduled = false;

                function storageGet(key) {
                    try {
                        var fromLocal = localStorage.getItem(key);
                        if (fromLocal != null) return fromLocal;
                    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
                    try {
                        return sessionStorage.getItem(key);
                    } catch (e2) {
                        return null;
                    }
                }

                function storageSet(key, value) {
                    try {
                        localStorage.setItem(key, value);
                        return;
                    } catch (e) { /* fall through */ }
                    try {
                        sessionStorage.setItem(key, value);
                    } catch (e2) { /* ignore */ }
                }

                function storageRemove(key) {
                    try { localStorage.removeItem(key); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
                    try { sessionStorage.removeItem(key); } catch (e2) { /* ignore */ }
                }

                function isCommerceReferrer() {
                    if (!document.referrer) return false;
                    try {
                        var host = new URL(document.referrer).hostname.toLowerCase();
                        // Public Optimizely hosts — not Commerce.
                        if (/^www(-int|-preprod|-qa)?\.bentley\.com$/.test(host)) return false;
                        // Adobe Commerce / Virtuosity hosts, e.g. mcstaging.us.bentley.com
                        return /(^|\.)mc(staging)?\d*\./.test(host)
                            || host.indexOf('virtuosity') !== -1;
                    } catch (e) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                function hasPending() {
                    var raw = storageGet(pendingKey);
                    if (raw == null || raw === '') return false;
                    // Legacy boolean flag from earlier builds.
                    if (raw === '1') return true;
                    var at = parseInt(raw, 10);
                    if (isNaN(at)) return true;
                    if ((Date.now() - at) > pendingMaxAgeMs) {
                        storageRemove(pendingKey);
                        return false;
                    }
                    return true;
                }

                function shouldAttempt() {
                    return hasPending() || isCommerceReferrer();
                }

                function inLoopWindow() {
                    var previous = storageGet(loopKey);
                    if (!previous) return false;
                    var previousAt = parseInt(previous, 10);
                    return !isNaN(previousAt) && (Date.now() - previousAt) < loopMs;
                }

                function goSilent() {
                    scheduled = false;
                    if (inLoopWindow()) return;
                    if (!shouldAttempt()) return;
                    storageRemove(pendingKey);
                    storageSet(loopKey, String(Date.now()));

                    if (inLoopWindow()) return;
                    if (!shouldAttempt()) return;
